ko: 오토바이·자전거 라이더들이 더 많이 쓰는 디스크 브레이크 잠금장치의 정체
소중한 자전거랑 오토바이 도난당할까 봐 불안했던 사람들 사이에서 난리가 났다는데

더 대박인 건 손바닥에 쏙 올라오는 크기로 주머니에 넣어 다니면 된다는 거

en: The secret behind the disc brake lock that every motorcycle and bike rider is using now.
People were getting so stressed about their bikes and motorcycles getting stolen, but this is changing everything.
It is actually a disc brake lock.
It is honestly insane how it saves you from the nightmare of carrying around those heavy chain locks.
No more neurosis from wrapping chains and fumbling with keys every time you park.
You just press it once with one touch and it locks instantly.
It even puts an end to the pain of your ride being cut through by a saw in just seconds.
Say goodbye to the stress of having your precious ride stolen right from under you.
It is made with high-strength alloy that is completely cut-resistant.
The best part is it fits right in your palm, so you can just toss it in your pocket.
Now that is what I call a genius invention.

en: The secret behind the insane cleaner taking over American kitchens.
It’s gone viral with American home cooks for cleaning everything from burnt grills to nasty drain grime.
It’s called Bar Keepers Friend.
The crazy thing is, even if you scrubbed forever with a regular sponge,
the stubborn grease and burn marks on your pans,
this stuff just melts them away without a trace.
And even for those hard-to-reach spots,
like stove grates or sink crevices,
it cleans every nook and cranny until they look brand new.
The best part is it comes in both powder and liquid forms, so it won’t even drip.
It’s a total hit with home cooks everywhere.
